registries.name: contract_catalog
registries.description: Canonical catalog for generated event/schema/id/operation registry views.

registries.name: error_codes
registries.description: Standard service-level and per-item error code registry.

registries.name: account_data_types
registries.description: Canonical Account Data key-pattern registry for actor/private account state.

registries.name: mls_extensions
registries.description: Canonical registry of Arkret-defined MLS GroupContext extension codepoints in the private-use range.

registries.name: exporter_labels
registries.description: Canonical registry of media-key MLS-Exporter labels (Context field shape, output length, applicable profiles, grandfathering, no-reuse rules).

registries.name: signature_algorithms
registries.description: Canonical signature algorithm vocabulary for proof alg and raw signature_algorithm schema enums.

registries.name: mls_ciphersuites
registries.description: Canonical MLS ciphersuite vocabulary for KeyPackage cipher_suites[] negotiation; unregistered suites fail closed.

registries.name: hpke_suites
registries.description: Canonical HPKE (RFC 9180) suite (KEM x KDF x AEAD) vocabulary for non-MLS application-layer public-key sealing (key-backup recovery_public_key, did_recovery, to-device ak.secret.send, member-application and file-transfer key envelopes); unregistered suites fail closed. Fourth algorithm-agility registry alongside signature-alg, digest-suite and mls-ciphersuite.

registries.name: relation_kinds
registries.description: Canonical machine index of the v1 standard relation_kind vocabulary (kind list, cardinality class, truth-source class, writability); detailed semantics stay in zh/models/relation.md.

registries.name: digest_suites
registries.description: Canonical digest suite (canonicalization x hash tuple) vocabulary for typed digest wire prefixes and the Realm digest_algorithm value space.

registries.name: reducer_profiles
registries.description: Canonical reducer profile definitions and digest input rules for federation reducer_profile_digest comparison.

registries.name: proposal_merges
registries.description: Canonical accepted-AKP merge manifest mapping historical proposals to formal v1 normative sections, schemas, registries, and fixtures.

registries.name: event_kinds
registries.description: Generated registry view for standard ak.* Event.kind values and wire scopes.

registries.name: id_kinds
registries.description: Generated registry view for ak:<kind>: typed ID prefixes and storage/wire rules.

registries.name: operations
registries.description: Generated registry view for service operation IDs across HTTP, gRPC, and message-queue surfaces.

registries.name: capability_actions
registries.description: Generated registry view for canonical capability action vocabulary, risk tiers, required constraints, and event_kind targets.

registries.name: registry_manifest
registries.description: Index of every machine-readable registry file under artifacts/registry.

registries.name: vectors
registries.description: Canonical machine index of ak.vector.* conformance vector identifiers and their defining prose/fixture sources.

registries.name: schemas
registries.description: Generated registry view for active schema IDs and schema file locations.

registries.name: morph_type_decision_table
registries.description: Canonical merge precedence + conflict rules for the four Morph type declaration sources (schema_refs, realm morph_type_profiles, morph_type, facets). Referenced normatively from zh/models/morph.md §4.

registries.name: forbidden_wire_fields
registries.description: Field names that MUST NOT appear in specified wire contexts (envelope / payload). Consumed by cotest drift scanner.

registries.name: forbidden_model_terms
registries.description: Terms that MUST NOT be used in current-model prose, code identifiers, or UI copy. Consumed by cotest drift scanner.

registries.name: operations_error_mapping
registries.description: Canonical endpoint -> operation-specific error code map. Layered on top of the universal failure surface (auth / schema / rate-limit / internal). Cross-linked from zh/sync/service-http-binding.md §2.3.

registries.name: profiles_dependency_graph
registries.description: Canonical DAG view of profile inherits / depends_on / mutually_exclusive_with edges, mirroring profile_requirements[<id>] relations in profiles/conformance-profiles.json. Rendered as a visualization aid in zh/conformance/conformance-profiles.md §2.1. Must be kept in sync when profile inheritance changes; conformance-profiles.json remains the source-of-truth for individual profile shape.
